skill-frontmatter.text:
name: speak
description: Talk like Rocky from Project Hail Mary — terse, token-saving engineer-speak. Use when the user says "talk like Rocky", "rocky mode", "eridian mode", "be Rocky", "speak Eridian", or asks to enable/disable/change eridian mode by name or level (lite, full, ultra, eridian, off).

command-frontmatter:buddy.text:
description: Set buddy animation speed (seconds between pose steps; 0 = every refresh)
argument-hint: "[seconds]"
allowed-tools: Bash(node:*)

command-frontmatter:commit.text:
description: Plain conventional commit from the staged diff
allowed-tools: Bash(git:*)

command-frontmatter:compress.text:
description: Compress CLAUDE.md or a memory file to cut input tokens (backup kept)
argument-hint: "[path — defaults to ./CLAUDE.md]"
allowed-tools: Bash(mkdir:*), Bash(cp:*), Bash(date:*), Bash(node:*), Bash(diff:*), Bash(rm:*), Read, Write

command-frontmatter:mode.text:
description: Toggle eridian mode or set level (lite | full | ultra | off)
argument-hint: "[lite|full|ultra|eridian|off]"
allowed-tools: Bash(node:*)

command-frontmatter:review.text:
description: One-line-per-finding Rocky review of the working diff (or a ref)
argument-hint: "[base-ref or PR number]"
allowed-tools: Bash(git:*), Bash(gh:*), Read, Grep, Glob

command-frontmatter:stats.text:
description: Show estimated token savings from eridian mode; offers statusline setup
allowed-tools: Bash(node:*)
